Title: Public preview: Cost analysis add-on for AKS

Body.Content:
AKS Cost Analysis add-on for AKS, now available in public preview, is a native Azure Portal experience that breaks down underlying cluster infrastructure costs by Kubernetes specific constructs such as cluster and namespace.

The add-on is built on top of OpenCost, a CNCF Sandbox project, and is available for Standard and Premium tier AKS clusters. You can access cost allocation data directly in Azure Portal UI.

With deeper visibility, you are better equipped to tackle everyday cost monitoring, allocation, and cost optimization scenarios.

To learn more, visit: https://aka.ms/aks/cost-analysis
